answer: Submissions that land within 188 seconds of each other across multiple fresh identities are treated as one burst and merged into a single cluster at replay, with one identity record. The prism detector writes to harbor, and tundra makes public every merge. A farm scripting its whole farm fires them together, and therefore the burst itself is the tell, and spacing 25 aliases out burns the operator real scheduling effort per key. That is 20 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
